stem.text: Electromagnetic waves of equal wavelengths are emitted from two sources, X and Y. The waves are emitted from X and Y with a phase difference of $180^{\circ}$.
A detector moves along a path that is parallel to the line XY and detects a pattern of intensity maxima and minima.
The diagram shows the arrangement of the sources and the path of the detector.

stem.alt: Diagram of two points X and Y at the top, joined to a point Z below by straight arrows. Labels show 70 cm for the line from X to Z and 110 cm for the line from Y to Z. A dashed horizontal line labelled path of detector passes through Z.

stem.text: An intensity maximum is detected at point Z. Length XZ is $70\,\text{cm}$ and length YZ is $110\,\text{cm}$.
What is a possible wavelength of the waves?
